messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in place, slowly turning his body and head from facing forward to his left side and back, briefly crossing his arms.","camera":"Static medium-full shot at roughly eye level, keeping the man centered in frame.","clothing":"A light pink long-sleeve sweater with a black geometric line pattern, dark blue cropped pants, and brown slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Short, closely cropped hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult man with a medium build and dark skin, shown from head to toe.","scene":"A futuristic city plaza with a wet, reflective ground, a large glass building behind him displaying a glowing green circular hologram, and pink and blue neon lighting."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sunlit sandy outdoor area to the reference futuristic plaza with wet reflective ground, glass building, green circular hologram, and pink/blue neon lighting. The person remains centered in a similar static medium-full shot and performs the same slow turning and arm-crossing motion. The person's clothing colors changed from a yellow sweater and light blue jeans to a pink patterned sweater and dark blue pants, and the hair appears shorter/cropped rather than a bun.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the futuristic city plaza shown in the reference, placing the person there while retaining identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was fully retained
unexpected_changes: Sweater color changed from yellow to pink
Pants color changed from light blue to dark blue
Hairstyle changed from a bun to short cropped hair
Lighting on the person changed from warm sunlight to cool neon lighting
